name: gta-6-reviews-november-18-report
note: تقرير: NateTheHate (X, 26 Oct) says Rockstar has begun sending GTA VI review code; Insider Gaming says it independently verified that reviews go live 18 Nov. Rockstar and Take-Two have not announced it. Footage: Rockstar's official launch trailer (IGN 4K file, x1.0), shots set on the trailer's own cuts (scene detect), clear of the slates, the intimate scenes (41.7-46.3), the guns (19.0-20.4, 27.2-28.7, 63.4-66.4) and the billboard text. Sound: the trailer's music from 13.6 s (faster-whisper: no words from 12.8 to 58.5 s). Sheet: shot 9 flag is a small background sign behind Lucia; shot 7 framed left of the billboard.
